[[File:CROUS-mango1.jpg|thumbnail|Learning to cook by watching a TV show is [[passive learning]]: Learning to cook by cooking is '''participative learning'''.]]

'''Participative learning''' is a style of learning in which learners participate in the organisation and construction of their course of learning.

== The human factor ==

According to ''[[Source:No Limits to Learning (Book)|Botkin et al.]]'', working relationships fostering simultaneously [[cooperation]] and [[autonomy]] is essential for facilitating effective participative learning.<ref>{{#cite:Q2658}}</ref>
